digest.component_or_area: src/rebar module-size gate and file organization
propositions: Six src/rebar files (inbound_differ.py, apply_inbound_records.py, det_floor.py, executor.py, prompts.py, init.py) are at or within 20 lines of the locked 800-LOC hard cap, blocking any new edits including comments without exceeding the limit.
The CI module-size gate has no allowlist and the limit is locked, so edits to files at 799-800 LOC fail the build; Gerrit 1916 failed by adding a six-line comment to a 798-LOC file.

Each in-scope file must be split along existing logical concerns and architectural call-graph seams, not mechanically, with no resulting file under 100 LOC and real headroom preserved (target 200-500 LOC per file after split).
The 800-LOC limit may not be raised; existing tests must pass unmodified after splits; complexity ratchet and lint/typecheck must report no new or increased violations.
_config_sources.py (791 LOC) is newly uncovered after its owner work closed and must be included in scope.
Census figures are stale due to recent merges; current LOC counts for near-cap files must be re-measured against origin/main before selecting extraction targets.
